name: Christian Freedom Foundation

summary.text: The Christian Freedom Foundation was launched in 1950 by Howard E. Kershner, who edited its publication Christian Economics for most of its 25-year run. The Philanthropy Roundtable says J. Howard Pew was instrumental in the foundation, which distributed the newsletter to about 180,000 ministers. Its records are held at California State University, Fullerton.
